title: Where the photos were taken: Milwaukee or Canada
summary: They guess the pictures were not taken in New Orleans, perhaps Milwaukee or Canada, and that the brass band is not a dance band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: This one with all the trees, it looks like it could be either in a park or in the country. It could be, yeah. Was this around New Orleans, do you think?
No, no, there's none of these pictures taken in New Orleans.
Except this one big one here.
So it might be near Milwaukee, you think, or someplace?
I don't know where that one was taken. It was sent to me.
You don't remember where that came from?
It must be Milwaukee. Because it doesn't look like anything around here.

Or if it was sent to you, you might have been out on the road with one of these shows, you think? It was sent to me, yeah. Might be that. So the chances are that most of these fellows might not be from New Orleans then, I guess. Yes. Oh, I hardly think.
With the trees, it may not have been. I don't think these fellows are from New Orleans either. Or the ones from Canada.
No, they say it's Canada. Probably a Canadian band.
Does that look like a regular brass band? Papa band. Papa player and all kinds of bands. It's not a dance band. It's not a dance band. They have their uniforms there.
